title: Customer Portal: a customer's own part sale note still works
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (the standard Admin role). This is User A.
  2. A part sale at this location: top menu Parts -> Part Sales -> New Part Sale, pick the Customer and click Save. Use a customer that has a Customer Portal login for one of its contacts.
  3. The Customer Portal login for that customer contact (ask the account admin for it if you do not have it).
  4. For comparison, a service work order for the same customer.
custom_steps:
1. Sign in to the Customer Portal as the customer contact and open the part sale.
  2. Add a note, then edit it, attach a file to it, and delete it.
  3. Do the same on the service work order.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • On the part sale the customer can see their new note, edit it, add an attachment and delete it.
  • On the service work order, notes behave exactly as before.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; task SV-10739 (Customer Portal Notifications changes: read part sale notes), Acceptance criteria; read 5 Oct 2026 (task In Progress). Source-verified 5 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • SV-10739 Acceptance criteria: “A new portal note on a part sale can be seen, edited, deleted and given attachments.”
  • SV-10739 Acceptance criteria: “Notes on service work orders behave exactly as before.”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
